description: Runs a fixture-backed Web platform semantics probe for Event.stopPropagation preventing ancestor delivery while remaining same-target listeners still fire. The scripted CDP driver observes page output from the self-hosted fixture `/v2/wpt_b/dom_event_stopprop`, and the server-side grader compares it with the Chrome-baked expected answer.
title: stopPropagation blocks ancestors but not same-target listeners
